# 4 Maccabees Chapter 17 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Greek MS (Codex Sinaiticus) | **Section:** The Martyrs' Divine Contest and Victory

---

**17:1** Truly the contest in which they were engaged was divine, and the virtue by which they were tested was the virtue of endurance.

**17:2** The prizes for which they were competing were incorruptible prizes of immortality and undying glory.

**17:3** Eleazar was the first in their number, and the mother of the seven was the second in command, and the brothers took the third place.

**17:4** The tyrant was the adversary, and the world was the arena.

**17:5** These sacred and pious athletes were crowned by God as victors.

**17:6** Who of those who have heard of the courage of these brothers was not moved? Who was not stirred to tears?

**17:7** The victory of these holy men, their endurance and their faithful deaths, has filled all the world with admiration and glory for Israel.

**17:8** And through the one mother and the seven brothers, tyranny was conquered and piety was shown to be invincible.

**17:9** For they overcame the tyrant by their endurance, and thus their nation was purified through them.

**17:10** Now it is fitting for me to call blessed this holy woman and mother of the seven sons.

**17:11** Pure woman, holy woman, the mother of these seven sons!

**17:12** You kept your sons faithful to the ancient way; you set them on the path of virtue; and thus you sent them to God.

**17:13** O woman whose memory is eternal! Who can speak as fittingly of you as you deserve?

**17:14** You endured a contest greater than any other; you gave up not just your own life but seven lives, the lives of your beloved sons.

**17:15** You labored nine months for each of them, and raised them through years of toil, and then you gave them all back to God.

**17:16** You kept devotion to God greater than the love of children, and reason greater than the love of life.

**17:17** Therefore God will receive you as worthy of him and will repay you the honor that is your due.

**17:18** Through your holy reason you governed all your passions and proved that reason is truly sovereign.

**17:19** O mother who alone surpassed all women in the contest for the crown of piety!

**17:20** You are the mother of the nation, the champion of the law, the defender of piety.

**17:21** You are worthy of a divine and eternal song of praise from all people.

**17:22** For you were tried in the furnace of suffering and came forth as gold.

**17:23** Therefore let this mother take her place at the right hand of God, together with Abraham and all the patriarchs of our faith.
